subject: Next steps & data handoff: POC prompt/log transfer and evaluation plan
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha@datacrest.ai>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@datacrest.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Sep 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo sync: prompt/log transfer & initial success criteria

Hi Samantha / Jordan —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're all aligned for the POC kickoff: 

Summary (from today's call)
- Goal: validate Redwood inference on DataCrest’s customer support routing logs to improve triage accuracy while keeping latency under 250ms median.
- Scope: ~2k–5k customer-support prompts (historic queries) + ~50 representative conversations for end-to-end eval.
- Success criteria (customer-provided + Redwood proposal):
  - Precision@1 >= 78% on routing label task across evaluation set
  - Median generation latency <= 250ms at 1 rps baseline
  - No PII in shared logs (see data hygiene section below)

What we need from DataCrest
1) Prompt/log sample: a CSV or JSONL with up to 500 representative prompts and labels (sample rows) for initial calibration. Include column headers and a short README.
2) Full transfer method: prefer a pre-signed S3 upload to a dedicated bucket we provide, or a secure SFTP endpoint. Indicate which you prefer.
3) Security items: Confirm whether a DPA is required and whether logs must be redacted/hashed — briefly state what fields are sensitive.

Redwood deliverables & timeline (proposed)
- Day 0–2: Provision dedicated sandbox + S3 endpoint; sign DPA if required. (Owner: Ben)
- Day 3–7: Ingest sample prompts, run baseline eval, return initial report and failure modes. (Owner: Connor)
- Week 2–3: Iterate on prompt formatting and batching to meet latency/cost targets; provide tuned config for trial. (Owner: Ben + LA)

Action items (for kickoff)
- Samantha: share sample prompt file (CSV/JSONL) and confirm transfer mechanism by EOD Wed.
- DataCrest legal: confirm DPA requirement and any export controls.
- Redwood: we will spin up sandbox and share credentials once transfer method is confirmed.

Attachments: I attached a POC requirements spreadsheet and security summary for your security team to review.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
From: Samantha Cole <samantha@datacrest.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@datacrest.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Sep 2028 09:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo sync: prompt/log transfer & initial success criteria

Connor —

Thanks for the concise summary. We're aligned on goals and appreciate the proposed milestones. Quick answers below and we attached a small sample.

1) Sample file: attaching datacrest_prompt_sample_v1.csv (500 rows) — columns: id, raw_text, routing_label, customer_tier. We scrubbed direct PII but left hashed ids.
2) Transfer method: happy to use pre-signed S3. We'll upload to your bucket once you send the presigned URL.
3) DPA: Our legal prefers a short DPA for data handling for POCs. I'll loop in our contracts person if needed; for now we're fine with a standard Redwood DPA template.

Additional context:
- Logs scope: support transcripts from Jan–Mar 2028; we can provide a 30k-row export after initial sample validation.
- Evaluation priorities: label accuracy > latency to start; cost targets will be secondary in trial.

Next steps: please send the S3 details and the DPA draft. We expect to complete upload within 48 hours of receiving the presigned URL.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Cole
Head of Automation | DataCrest Analytics
samantha@datacrest.ai | +1 (617) 555-0999

Attachment: datacrest_prompt_sample_v1.csv (text/csv, 120KB)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 6 Sep 2028 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: DataCrest POC — tasks & owners (urgent)

Team —

Samantha sent the 500-row sample and confirmed pre-signed S3 upload + a DPA. High priority to get the sandbox and transfer ready so they upload within 48 hours. Quick assignments: 

- Ben: provision the dedicated s3 bucket + generate presigned PUT URL. Ensure bucket lifecycle doesn't retain beyond POC without explicit approval. Also attach the Redwood security summary to the upload instructions.
- Lauren: draft the short DPA (use the standard template) and route to DataCrest legal; flag any export-control clauses.
- Me: once upload lands, run baseline eval, deliver initial report with Precision@1 and latency distribution. I expect to need 2–3 config passes.

Let’s sync briefly at 11am PT today for handoff (15 minutes). I’ll bring the sample and initial eval checklist.

—Connor
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha@datacrest.ai>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@datacrest.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 7 Sep 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo sync: prompt/log transfer & initial success criteria

Samantha / Jordan —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the sample — received and validated. Confirming next steps and an explicit milestone map so everyone has dates: 

POC milestone map (agreed)
- 2028-09-07: Redwood shares presigned S3 URL + short DPA draft. (Ben / Lauren)
- 2028-09-09: DataCrest uploads full 30k export (or smaller subset to start) and notifies Redwood. (Samantha)
- 2028-09-10 to 2028-09-13: Baseline run and initial report delivered (Precision@1, latency percentiles, failure-mode examples). (Connor)
- 2028-09-14 to 2028-09-20: Iteration window — prompt formatting, batching, quantization suggestions to meet latency targets. (Ben + Connor)
- 2028-09-21: Checkpoint call to review results and agree on next phase (retained trial or next steps).

A handful of small asks before upload:
- Please confirm that the sample rows are representative (you said 500 rows used). If any particular customer segments are sensitive, note them in the README.
- For logs that contain potential PII, please hash or remove fields; we only need raw_text and routing_label for the eval.
- Let us know whether we should run evals in us-east or us-west region — defaulting to us-west for lower latency to your users unless you prefer otherwise.

I've attached the quick-start upload instructions and a security summary for your SOC review. Once we have the uploaded export, I'll run the baseline and share the deck with detailed metrics.

If anything changes on timing, flag it asap — otherwise we'll proceed on the timeline above.

Best,
Connor
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments referenced: datacrest_poc_requirements.xlsx, security_compliance_summary.pdf
